title: Tools are hands, and every hand is a permission
sub: The third film of nine in Agents at work on data: every tool an agent gets is a hand, and every hand is a permission; the fewest rights for each, set on the agent's own account; a pull request that two people approve; and a line hidden in a ticket that meets hands that can't do what it asks.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's matte style: the lab's grey marble wall and oak floor, and Oxford's old library in the same light. Blue is tools and structure, violet the model thinking, orange data coming back, green a check that passes, and amber a check that fails or a warning.
